name: 0.1.0-beta.10
notes:
# Folian Beta 0.10

Folian Beta 0.10 introduces Focused Writing, a calmer manuscript view designed for drafting and revision.

- Switch between Standard and Focused Writing from the manuscript toolbar.
- Keep the manuscript central while real project context and optional Folian intelligence remain available beside it.
- Move through chapters and scenes without leaving the focused view.
- Use Ask, Memory, Editorial and History from an independently scrollable context panel.
- Open project context as an accessible drawer on smaller windows and mobile Studio layouts.
- Return quickly to Chapters, Editing or Progress when broader project work is needed.
- Retain each project's preferred writing view and context-panel state on the current device.
- Use Folian without AI; Memory and project records remain available when no provider is connected.
- Use the native View → Focused Writing command on desktop.
- Benefit from shared behavior and terminology across Folian Desktop and Folian Studio.

This release does not change the project schema, desktop data path or Studio persistence model. Existing manuscripts and project records remain in their current storage.

Known limitations:

- Focused Writing preferences are device-specific rather than synchronized between devices.
- Desktop filesystem tools and updates remain desktop-only. Authentication and cloud persistence remain Studio-only.
